probes.name: GOSUB into a FOR body before entering the loop
probes.source:
10 GOSUB 40
20 GOTO 80
30 FOR I=1 TO 2
40 PRINT "SUBROUTINE";I
50 RETURN
60 NEXT I
80 END

probes.name: GOSUB into a FOR body after the loop completes
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 2
20 GOTO 50
30 PRINT "SUBROUTINE";I
40 RETURN
50 NEXT I
60 GOSUB 30
70 END

probes.name: GOSUB into an active FOR body
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 2
20 GOSUB 40
30 GOTO 60
40 PRINT "SUBROUTINE";I
50 RETURN
60 NEXT I
70 END

probes.name: GOTO into an inactive FOR body
probes.source:
10 GOTO 40
30 FOR I=1 TO 2
40 PRINT "BODY";I
50 GOTO 70
60 NEXT I
70 END

probes.name: conditional branch and GOTO inside a called FOR body
probes.source:
10 GOSUB 40
20 GOTO 80
30 FOR I=1 TO 2
40 IF I=0 THEN 50
45 PRINT "SKIP"
50 PRINT "BODY";I
55 GOTO 58
58 RETURN
60 NEXT I
80 END

probes.name: nested RETURN to a called FOR body
probes.source:
10 GOSUB 40
20 GOTO 100
30 FOR I=1 TO 2
40 GOSUB 80
50 PRINT "BODY";I
60 RETURN
70 NEXT I
80 PRINT "NESTED";I
90 RETURN
100 END
